tests.name: phone + desktop: /admin/marketplace/rewards renders its sections (or the exafy-only state / role gate), the three admin GETs answer 200|403 JSON, no raw keys, no overflow (read-only, no save)
Admin Rewards Shop: 403 state, item PUT body, photo shrink + upload, fee add/delete, missing-fee warning, order status change, DE/EN parity
tests.reason: Every action on this screen is a write to the production database (staging shares it), so saves, uploads, fee changes and status changes cannot run on staging. These Vitest suites drive the real page, hook and form over a mocked gateway and prove the exact request each action sends, the validation, the image size loop and the 403 state; the staging spec above proves the deployed screen renders read-only.
